meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式多智能体辩论打磨出最严谨的计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在制定计划时彻底暴露假设漏洞和过度设计。
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through adversarial multi-agent debate
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your plans.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会组建一个5人敌对团队，让他们互相攻击对方的方案，只保留经得起攻击的见解，然后交给专门的规划工具生成可执行的计划。
howto.when: 当你提到“hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan”等关键词，或要求进行最严格的规划、暴露弱假设和盲点时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这个新功能。
say.note: 启动敌对多智能体规划流程。

say.text: hpp 分析当前架构的弱点。
say.note: 触发敌对团队对架构进行批判。

say.text: adversarial plan 评估这个方案。
say.note: 让敌对团队攻击方案，只保留可靠部分。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates a 5-member adversarial team that attacks each other's findings, distills only the insights that survive, then hands them to a planner for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', or similar keywords, or when you request maximum rigor in planning to surface weak assumptions and blind spots.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this new feature.
say_en.note: Starts the adversarial multi-agent planning process.

say_en.text: hpp analyze the weaknesses of the current architecture.
say_en.note: Triggers adversarial team critique of the architecture.
Team attacks the proposal, keeping only robust parts.
